questions.markdown:
Implement the following Boolean functions using PAL with four inputs and 3-wide AND-OR structure

$$
F_1(A,B,C,D)=\Sigma m(7,8,9,10,11,12,13,14,15)
$$

$$
F_2(A,B,C,D)=\Sigma m(1,2,8,12,13)
$$
Implement a mod-12 ripple up-counter using negative edge triggered JK flipflops and draw the output timing diagrams.
Write a Verilog structural code to implement 4:1 multiplexer using instances of 2:1 multiplexers in dataflow.

Design a 3-bit self-correcting synchronous counter using JK flip-flops that follows the sequence 0-1-2-4 repeatedly, ensuring that any unused states automatically go to the 0-state on the next clock pulse.

What is the role of Cache in computer memory organization? If a cache has 95% hit ratio, an access time of 100 ns on a cache-hit, and an access time of 800 ns on a cache-miss, compute the effective access time.
Differentiate between hardware description language (such as Verilog) and C language.
Design a Mealy synchronous sequential circuit using D flip-flops that will function as prescribed by the state diagram shown below.

questions.markdown: Express the given statement in three, two and one instruction addressing formats: $D=(A+B)\times(C+D)$
What are the different hazards in pipelining? Explain them with an example for each.
Write the Verilog code in behavioral modeling to implement a 3-bit synchronous binary counter using negative edge-triggered T flip-flops.
Define the following addressing modes with an example for each type: (i) register-indirect, (ii) autoincrement, (iii) indexed (displacement) and (iv) immediate
Explain the operation of a general register-based computer organization.
